name: com.example.nhatpham.camerafilter.PreviewActivity
description: Pham Quang Sang’s CameraFilter (ImageFilter) library uses this Activity for its camera and media editor; release 0.0.1 registers it as the launcher, and it asks for camera, microphone and storage access before showing camera, gallery, photo/video preview and editing screens.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents these camera and media screens from opening and blocks app launch in release 0.0.1.
